qualityTargetAssessment: Not achieved as a final-quality sign-off. All 33 are structurally valid review drafts; visible anatomical and cross-view consistency shortcomings remain.
geometryNotes: Four generated alpha silhouettes intersected on the requested grid; an inscribed round-section carve removes boxy torso corners.
Thin appendages are separately tapered from image masks. Cetacean flukes are corrected to a horizontal plane.
Cephalopod arms use traced top-mask skeletons with loop-terminal recovery and a root bridge to the hull. Arm rest centers share a level plane; thickness is bounded by the side silhouette.
All cephalopod arms share the requested ten-bone contract; there are no individual six-joint arm chains.
knownLimitations: Independently generated views have residual pose and anatomical inconsistencies. Matching alpha extents does not make them an exact calibrated multi-view capture.
Visual hull cannot recover concave facial features, paw joints or sucker relief from silhouettes alone.
The requested ten-bone skeleton is retained; independent multi-joint control of each cephalopod arm is not included.
